title: Savory German Vegetable Biryani
description: A hearty vegetarian dish that brings the flavors of Germany and India together in a delicious biryani. This recipe features a variety of sautéed vegetables and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and carrots. Sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add the zucchini, allspice, and garam masala. Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the basmati rice to the pan and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the rice is lightly toasted.
Transfer the mixture to a large saucepan or Dutch oven.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
